title: ResolveConflict
description: The owner resolves one whole conflict set in one commit. person_id and daemon_id sit on the command. A member row has no actor. Factory #946. ADR-0034.

person_id.description: The owner who resolved the set.

members.description: The whole conflict set. At most one state is approved. A rejected member is currently tracked. A superseded member is currently approved, and the approved member is its successor. All rejected is valid.
